## Document File Preview — PDF (PV)

The PDF family's renderer, and the shortest one here for a good reason: **the browser is the reader**.

Embedded and isolated mount the document in a native `<object>` viewer — scrolling, selection and search come for free. Re-implementing any of that in 1,000 lines of canvas would be strictly worse than the thing already in the browser.

### Fitted shows a placeholder, not a PDF engine per tile

A budgeted collection cell gets a lightweight page placeholder. A grid of 40 PDFs must not boot 40 document engines.

### The poster is waiting on a contract, not on effort

Same as `OfficePreview`: the first-page poster needs the derived-artifact contract (CS-12231) to rasterize and store a page image. When that lands and populates `thumbnailUrl`, the preview stage prefers the real poster **automatically, with no change to this component**.

132 lines. Most of the work is deciding what *not* to build.


Projected into the four format shells by `FilePreviewStage`, which owns the loading, failure and staleness panes.
